label: Which bytes of a release candidate must be identical when the same commit is built again, which are identical except for named run-specific fields, and which belong to one run. Held by tests/test_release_reproducibility.py (two builds in separate fresh clones with different paths, time zones, locales and umasks) and by the supply-chain workflow's rebuild job (a second build on a different runner image, compared with the signed candidate). A comparison here is BYTE IDENTITY of files, never numerical equivalence.

byte_identical.source.zip: every tracked file of the commit, read from the object store, members in sorted order with a fixed timestamp and mode, STORED uncompressed. Nothing in it depends on a deflate implementation, so its bytes are a function of the commit and of the zip container format alone.
byte_identical.sbom.cdx.json: derived from the commit's dependency declarations alone, serialized with sorted keys

provenance.intoto.json.why: the hosted run id and attempt, by design: the provenance says which run built it

index.json.why: the provenance's digest, which carries the invocation id

run_specific.SHA256SUMS: lists the provenance and index digests, so it is run-specific; it is what is signed
run_specific.SHA256SUMS.sigstore.json: a short-lived certificate for one workflow run, its signature and a transparency-log entry with an integration time
run_specific.rekor_entry.json: the transparency-log index and time of one signature

not_claimed: byte identity of any file built from a dirty working tree (refused by build without --allow-dirty)
reproducibility of the environments the SBOM describes; only their declarations are bound

verifier_requirements.python: >=3.11 (tomllib); the verifier imports only the standard library
verifier_requirements.sigstore_runtime: integrations/supply_chain/sigstore.lock, installed with every wheel by hash

evidence.local: tests/test_release_reproducibility.py, two fresh clones; tools/offline_verify.py run from a directory holding nothing but itself, inside a network namespace with no interfaces
evidence.hosted: supply-chain.yml jobs rebuild-elsewhere (ubuntu-22.04) and offline-verify (no repository checkout beyond the verifier, network removed)
